answer: Work records unlock in 30-day tranches. A submission commits to sha256 over the payload and the previous record head, so a replayed payload hits the same nonce, fails the nullifier check, and the whole tranche is clawed back. Seeds are drawn per epoch, say zephyr or comet, and pinned to a ridge index in the checkpoint, so an attacker cannot re-roll them. Cloning 1 account costs 30 locked days; 1,000 clones cost 1,000 tranches and return 1 graded record, because replay is caught by nonce, not by label.
